EDIT: I got a lot farther than I ever have recently. enemy variety is better than I remember and DOES change up when you get farther. However a lot of them still look very similar and it ends out feeling similar. Just wanted to say it's not just "the same robots all game" but it is similar looking robots that get more and more advanced the farther you get.

Game seems to have gone through multiple large scale changes lately.
But now that the latest beta has dropped, this is the best the game has felt IMO in the past 3 big updates.
To put it quickly, this is a shooter/roguelike like Gunfire Reborn or basically first person risk of rain though it doesnt get as insane as risk of rain can get. Think risk of rain if it was counterstrike.

Latest update has the best feeling progression system ingame I've felt yet. You pick a class, you can get some passive perks, you head into the game. You gain xp from killing enemies, leveling up gives you a boost to stats and lets you pick from a few perk selections that enhance gameplay depending on your class. So the stealth guy can stay stealthed when attacking or the shield guy can attack faster while his shield is up etc. They stack and combine into insane combos. My favorite gameplay style is doing melee recon with the laser cutlass and shooting energy waves that auto crit every 5 kills with my cutlass.
Then there's generic stat boost items that drop/appear in shops/chests this is pretty roguelike standard but they recently made it a good system rather than a limited one.
The guns have lots of random buffs on them that I enjoy a lot. This includes chance to do things when firing, stat boosts, alt fires like shooting grenades. My favorite thing so far is getting something fast firing like smgs that have a chance to shotgun blast every shot. It does crazy good damage and it fits my style of gameplay a lot. Last night I got an LMG that shoots an explosive round every 4th shot and it was TEARING things up.

Regardless, this game's fun, it's getting better and going in a good direction right now. If you like Roguelike/FPS/rpg this ones a good one.

Best gunplay out of all the fps rougue-lites out there rn, bit lacking in variety compared to others as of this patch but is earlier in development. Also in need of some kind of ascension system I think as runs are too easy for me at this point.
Fun movement shooter rougelite, quirky art style and options for playstyle make for some replayability but new updates should help that. pick it up on sale!
Combat is fun. Music slaps. What more could you ask for?
